dashboardOverview.q: What does this view show me?
dashboardOverview.a: The Dashboard is your executive overview: total spent, active projects, overrun alerts and a portfolio snapshot. Use it as the daily landing page to spot which projects need attention.

dashboardAi.q: What is the AI Analysis section?
dashboardAi.a: The AI Analysis block flags the project that most needs your attention right now — either because it's exceeding budget or approaching its limit — so you can jump straight into it.

dashboardTrend.q: What does the financial trend chart show?
dashboardTrend.a: The dashed gold line is the planned budget over time, and the solid line is the actual spend computed from inventory movements. When the solid line overtakes the dashed line you're spending faster than planned.

projectsCreate.q: How do I create a project?
projectsCreate.a: Tap the highlighted New Project button to open the form. Fill in the name, dates and total budget, then save — your project will appear in the list and you can immediately add tasks, members and expenses to it.

projectsSearch.q: How do I find a specific project?
projectsSearch.a: Use the search field here to filter projects by name, and the status pills to narrow down by state. Click any project card to open its full detail view.

projectBudget.q: What does this budget card show?
projectBudget.a: This card shows how much of the project's total budget has been spent so far. The colored bar turns yellow around 80% and red at 100%, so you can spot risk at a glance.

projectTasks.q: How do I work with tasks?
projectTasks.a: Open the Tasks tab to create, assign, filter by priority or status, and close tasks. Closed tasks update the project's progress automatically.

projectMembers.a: Open Projects, pick the project and go to the Members tab: there you grant access by choosing someone from the company with their permissions, or share a project invitation link.

projectProgress.q: What is the Progress tab for?
projectProgress.a: Use Progress to log timeline updates — percentage complete, milestones and blockers. The dashboard and overview cards reflect these entries instead of just task counts.

inventoryCreate.q: How do I add a product?
inventoryCreate.a: Go to Sales > Charge, pick a project from the tabs above, then click New product to register an item. You'll set name, category, unit, initial stock and the unit cost that feeds into budget calculations.

inventorySell.q: How do I register a sale?
inventorySell.a: Go to Sales > Charge. Every product card has a Sell button. Tap it on each item the customer is buying — they'll show up in the Current Sale panel on the right, where you can fine-tune quantities with the + / − buttons or remove items with the X. Once the cart looks right, press Realizar venta: the system discounts stock and records a SALIDA inventory movement per product, impacting the linked project's budget.

inventoryMovements.a: Movements record any change in stock: ENTRADA adds units, SALIDA removes them, AJUSTE corrects discrepancies and GASTO_ADMIN logs administrative expenses. To register one manually, open the product card. If what you actually need is a sale, ask me about that instead — it has a dedicated cart flow.

inventoryFilter.q: How do I filter by project?
inventoryFilter.a: These tabs let you scope the inventory to a single project or view all projects together. Switching the tab also scopes any new movement to that project.

inventoryCategoryFilter.q: How do I filter by category?
inventoryCategoryFilter.a: The Category row shows categories assigned to the visible products. Choose one to hide the others; if only All appears, assign categories when creating or editing products first.

suppliersSearch.q: How do I find a supplier?
suppliersSearch.a: Type part of the supplier name, contact, phone number or email in the search field. The list updates as you type.

suppliersCreate.q: How do I add a supplier?
suppliersCreate.a: Click Add supplier and enter the name. Contact, phone and email are optional; save to add the supplier to the list.

suppliersDetails.q: What can I do with a supplier?
suppliersDetails.a: Open View details to review its information. If you have management permissions, you can also edit or delete it. The same email may be used by more than one supplier because it identifies a contact, not a user account.

addFunds.a: +Funds lets you inject more budget into the selected project. Pick the project from the top selector, click +Funds, enter the amount and a short reason. The new total appears in the project budget cards instantly.

addExpense.q: How do I record an expense?
addExpense.a: Use Add Expense to log a one-off cost (services, fees, admin overhead). It reduces the project's available budget straight away and is listed in the project's spending breakdown.

addActivity.q: How do I create a budgeted activity?
addActivity.a: Activities are line items inside a project's budget (e.g. "Construction", "Marketing"). Create one here and you'll be able to attribute expenses and inventory movements to it for clearer reporting.

budgetControl.a: Each project has a total budget that decreases as you log expenses or outgoing movements. The colored bar turns yellow at 80% used and red at 100% — keep an eye on it from this page or the project detail header.

reportsOverview.a: Reports gathers KPIs, financial performance and inventory activity. Pick a project from the filter bar at the top and switch between performance, breakdown and detail views.

chatStart.q: How do I start a conversation?
chatStart.a: Pick a teammate from the conversation list on the left or start a new chat — messages stream in real time and are linked to your workspace.

chatCall.a: Inside any conversation, use the call buttons in the header to start a voice or video call powered by WebRTC. Both sides need to be online to connect.

agentCapabilities.q: What can the AI agent do?
agentCapabilities.a: The agent can read live data from your projects — budgets, tasks, inventory, progress — and answer questions in natural language. Ask things like "which project is most overspent?" or "summarize team workload".

teamsCreate.q: How do I create a team?
teamsCreate.a: Use New Team to group members by area (Development, Design, QA…). Linking a project to a team doesn't grant access: access is granted in Project > Members.

integrationsList.a: This view lists every third-party service you can connect — payments, productivity, communications. Click a card to start the connection flow.

changeLanguage.q: How do I change the language?
changeLanguage.a: Click this language icon in the top bar, or go to Settings > Your preferences, and pick English or Español. Your choice is remembered in this browser.

switchWorkspace.a: This selector at the top lets you jump between companies you belong to. The whole portal — projects, inventory, budget — reloads scoped to the chosen workspace.

aiAgent.a: The AI link in the top navigation opens a conversational assistant that can query live project data, summarize budgets, and answer business questions about your workspace.

chat.a: The Chat section in the top nav gives you real-time conversations with teammates plus voice and video calls — useful for quickly aligning around a project or task without leaving Kontrol.

budgetGlobal.a: The Budget section is your control center: pick a project, then add funds, activities, expenses, or review the funding history and spending breakdown.

reportsShortcut.a: The Reports section gathers financial performance, inventory activity and project KPIs. Use the filter bar at the top to scope by project or date range, then drill into a specific report from the list.

inventoryShortcut.a: The Inventory section is the table of every product across your projects, with its price and stock; you can filter by project, search and see which ones are low or out of stock. To sell, create products or register movements, go to Sales > Charge.

dashboardShortcut.a: The Dashboard is your daily landing page: it surfaces total spent, active projects, overrun alerts and an AI-powered analysis of which project most needs your attention right now.

privacy.title: Your data and account
privacy.hint: Download this company's data or delete your personal access.
privacy.exportOwnerOnly: The complete export is available only to company owners and administrators.
privacy.deleteWhat: Deletion is immediate and has no grace period. Your account is disabled, login credentials and contact details are removed, your personal AI conversations and chat messages are deleted. Anonymized technical references needed by business records remain; operational logs may still contain identifiable data.
privacy.deleteRetained: Shared sales, expenses, projects, and other company records are not deleted. If you are the owner, ownership passes to an available active administrator or member; if no one remains, the company is closed: its data can be downloaded for 30 days and is deleted within 60. Other accounts are not deleted.
privacy.deleteDuration: For a company that is still in use, the current policy does not set a retention period for these records, so we cannot promise a deletion date while it stays active. To delete them, the owner can close the company. This does not claim that a law requires their retention.
privacy.deleteExternal: This operation does not delete data already sent to Google, email/SMS providers, the AI service, Cloudinary, or other integrations. There is no account-level deletion workflow for those providers; they may retain their own copies under periods that have not been verified. Business files are deleted only when the company is closed.
privacy.googleReauthSuccess: Google verified your identity. Confirm deletion to continue.
privacy.googleReauthError: Google account verification failed. Please try again.
privacy.finalConfirm: This action is irreversible. Personal access will be deleted and the described business records will be retained. Do you want to continue?
privacy.error: The operation could not be completed.

closure.title: Close the company
closure.what: Closing the company blocks its use, disables its invitations and integrations and opens a 30-day period to download its data. Afterwards all its records (projects, inventory, suppliers, sales, reports, evidence files and assistant history) are deleted no later than 60 days after the request, and backups no later than 90.
closure.kept: Member accounts, person-to-person chats, anything already sent to Slack, Teams, email, SMS or other integrations, and downloads someone already made are not deleted. You can cancel the closure while the download period is open.

tutorial.title: How to connect {name}
tutorial.intro: Follow these steps to set up the integration with {name}.

feedback.lastTestFailed: The last connection failed. Check the credentials and use "Test connection" before activating.

slack: Go to api.slack.com/apps and sign in with your Slack account.
Create a new app with "From scratch" and pick your workspace.
In the sidebar, open "Incoming Webhooks" and turn it on.
Click "Add New Webhook to Workspace" and choose the channel where you want the notifications.
Copy the generated webhook URL (it starts with https://hooks.slack.com/…) and paste it into the setup form.
sendgrid: Sign in to app.sendgrid.com with your SendGrid account.
Go to Settings → API Keys and click "Create API Key".
Give it a descriptive name and pick "Restricted Access" → "Mail Send: Full Access".
Copy the generated API key (it is shown only once) and keep it somewhere safe.
Paste the API key, your SendGrid-verified sender address and the address that will receive the alerts.
microsoft-teams: Open Microsoft Teams and go to the channel where you want the notifications.
Click "..." next to the channel name and pick "Connectors".
Find "Incoming Webhook" in the list and click "Configure".
Name the connector, upload an optional icon and click "Create".
Copy the generated webhook URL and paste it into the Kontrol setup form.
telegram: Open Telegram and search for the {'@'}BotFather bot.
Send the /newbot command and follow the instructions to pick a name and username for your bot.
BotFather will hand you a bot token. Copy it and keep it safe.
To get your chat ID: start a conversation with your bot and then query the API with the token, or use the {'@'}userinfobot bot.
Enter the bot token and the chat ID in the Kontrol setup form.
twilio-sms: Create an account at twilio.com, or sign in if you already have one.
The main dashboard shows your Account SID and Auth Token. Copy both.
Go to "Phone Numbers → Manage → Buy a number" to get the Twilio number the texts will be sent from.
Enter the Account SID, the Auth Token, the Twilio number and the destination number in the setup form.
webhook: Get ready the external server or service that will receive the events (it has to be publicly reachable).
The endpoint has to accept POST requests with a JSON body.
Use HTTPS, so the payload does not travel in the clear.
Copy your endpoint URL and paste it into the URL field of the setup form.
Kontrol will send a POST event every time something relevant happens in your company.
fallback: Get the credentials from the {name} platform.
Copy them into the Kontrol setup form.
Save the changes and use "Test connection" to check that everything works.

legal.title: Terms, Privacy & Compliance
legal.subtitle: Transparency on how Kontrol operates in Guatemala, data protection for your company, and service boundaries.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions of Service

clauses.title: 1. Who provides the service
clauses.body: Kontrol is a platform developed and operated by an independent team in Guatemala that is not yet incorporated as a company. For legal or privacy questions and complaints, write to {email}.

clauses.title: 2. Acceptance
clauses.body: To use Kontrol you must read and accept these Terms and the Privacy Notice; the platform will ask you to do so the first time you sign in. If you do not agree, do not use the service. You must be 18 or older and, if you act on behalf of a business or another person, have sufficient authority to do so.

clauses.title: 3. What Kontrol is
clauses.body: Kontrol is a private, independent platform for recording and managing business operations in Guatemala: projects, inventory, sales and budgets. It is not linked to, endorsed by, nor does it act as a reporting platform for SAT or any tax or financial authority.

clauses.title: 4. Point of sale and taxes
clauses.body: The point of sale (POS) and the configured VAT calculation are for your company's internal use: they do not issue certified electronic invoices (FEL) or replace your tax filings. You are responsible for issuing the required tax documents and for filing and paying your business's taxes.

clauses.title: 5. Payments and plans (test mode)
clauses.body: Kontrol does not charge anything for real. The Free, Pro and Business plans and their USD prices exist only as a demonstration: billing uses Stripe in test mode (TEST), which moves no money. Stripe does not operate in Guatemala, so this gateway cannot be used to charge for real; commercial operation will require replacing it with a provider authorized in the country. Payment happens only on Stripe's hosted page: Kontrol never receives or stores card data. Use only Stripe test cards and fictitious data; do not enter real cards or data. The subscription belongs to the company and only its owner can subscribe, change or cancel it; after cancelling, the plan lasts until the end of the period and the company then returns to the Free plan without losing its data. Your current access will not automatically become a paid service: before any real charge we will inform you of the terms and you will have to accept them expressly.

clauses.title: 6. Account, credentials and invitations
clauses.body: Provide truthful information and protect your credentials; do not share your password or leave your session open on shared devices. The owner or administrator is responsible for the accounts, invitations and permissions they grant, and each user is responsible for their own conduct within the system.

clauses.title: 7. Permitted use and third-party data
clauses.body: Use Kontrol only for lawful activities. Do not access other people's accounts or projects, bypass permissions or upload harmful software. If you record data about customers, employees or suppliers, you must have their authorization or another legal basis to do so. Do not upload passwords, cards or identity documents that are not necessary.

clauses.title: 8. Artificial intelligence assistant
clauses.body: The assistant's answers may contain errors or omissions. Review them before making decisions: they do not replace accounting, tax, legal or other professional advice.

clauses.title: 9. Your data and license of use
clauses.body: You keep ownership of your company's data. You only grant us the permission needed to host, process and display it to the people and services you authorize within the platform. We do not sell your information or use it to train artificial intelligence models. Access to Kontrol does not transfer ownership of the software to you.

clauses.title: 10. Availability and backups
clauses.body: Kontrol may have errors, outages or maintenance. For now we do not offer a guaranteed service level or guaranteed data recovery, so keep your own copies of anything important, for example with the PDF or CSV reports.

clauses.title: 11. Liability
clauses.body: Each party is responsible for its own acts. Kontrol does not exclude its liability for its own fraud or negligence under the laws of Guatemala, nor does it limit any non-waivable rights the law grants you.

clauses.title: 12. Suspension and termination
clauses.body: We may suspend or close access for unlawful or abusive use, unauthorized access, security risks or an order from a competent authority. Whenever possible, we will tell you the reason and you will be able to clarify it. Deactivating an account does not automatically delete its data.

clauses.title: 13. Changes to these Terms
clauses.body: If we change these Terms or the Privacy Notice, we will publish the new version here and ask you to accept it before you continue using the platform.

clauses.title: 14. Governing law and complaints
clauses.body: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Guatemala. Disputes will be resolved before the competent courts as provided by law, without prejudice to the rights granted to you by the Consumer and User Protection Law. You can submit complaints to {email}.

privacy.title: Privacy Notice

clauses.title: 1. Controller and contact
clauses.body: The Kontrol team decides on account data and on the operation of the platform. The data your business records about customers, employees or suppliers is processed following your business's instructions, and your business must be authorized to record it. Privacy contact: {email}.

clauses.title: 2. What data we process
clauses.body: Account data (name, email, phone number if you provide it, and password stored as a hash), your business data, inventory, suppliers, projects, tasks, budgets and sales, chat messages, attachments, assistant queries and technical session and security logs, such as your IP address. If you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email and Google identifier.

clauses.title: 3. What we use it for
clauses.body: To give you access, operate the features you use, enable collaboration within your company, send the alerts you configure and protect the security of the service, and to keep a record of which version of the Terms and of this Notice you accepted, when and from which IP address. We do not sell or commercially transfer personal data and we do not use it to train artificial intelligence models.

clauses.title: 4. Artificial intelligence assistant
clauses.body: Kontrol's assistant (Qwen/vLLM) runs on the team's own server located in Guatemala (ClawStitch). To answer, it receives your question and the necessary context: your email and role, the company, up to ten recent messages and limited samples of the queried data. The conversation history is stored so it can be shown to you, and you can delete it from the assistant.

clauses.title: 5. Who we share information with
clauses.body: With members of your company according to their permissions, and with providers that help us operate: database and hosting services, Cloudinary for attachments, and Google if you choose to sign in with Google. If your business connects Slack, Microsoft Teams, Telegram, SMS, email or webhooks, alerts are sent to those destinations according to your configuration. Some of these providers may process data outside Guatemala.

clauses.title: 6. How long we keep it
clauses.body: Retention periods by data type have not yet been defined. You can request account deletion from Settings: your profile is deactivated and anonymized, your credentials and memberships are removed, your personal assistant history and messages you sent in human chats are deleted. A conversation may remain for its other participants. Shared business records, files and logs may remain while the company is in use, and copies held by external providers are not removed. If you own a company, you can close it from Settings: you will have 30 days to download its data, and then its records, evidence files and assistant history are deleted no later than 60 days after the request, and backups no later than 90.

clauses.title: 7. Your rights
clauses.body: From Settings, a company owner or administrator can download the business data accessible to that account as JSON; the download is authenticated and does not use a public link. It includes minimal metadata for human chats involving the requester and their own messages, not other participants' messages or profiles. You can request account deletion in the same section using your password or by reauthenticating with Google. Deletion does not remove shared business records, logs or copies held by external providers, and their retention periods are not yet defined. This mechanism does not limit rights granted by applicable law.

clauses.title: 8. Security
clauses.body: We store passwords as hashes (bcrypt) and encrypt integration credentials. No system is infallible: if you detect a security problem or improper access, let us know immediately at {email}.

clauses.title: 9. Changes to this Notice
clauses.body: We will publish any change to this Privacy Notice on this page and, when relevant, ask you to accept it again.

cookies.title: Cookie and Local Storage Policy

clauses.title: 1. No own cookies and no tracking
clauses.body: Kontrol does not set its own cookies, advertising cookies or cross-site tracking. What it needs is kept in your browser's local storage (localStorage), which only the application itself reads.

clauses.title: 2. What is essential
clauses.body: Your session, your profile, your companies and permissions and your answer to the storage notice. Without this data you cannot sign in, so it cannot be rejected if you use the platform. Signing out removes the session, the profile and the companies; your answer to the notice is kept so you are not asked again. Your acceptance of the Terms is not stored in the browser but on Kontrol's servers.

clauses.title: 3. Session risk
clauses.body: Your session is kept in localStorage, and any code that manages to run on the Kontrol page can read it. If someone managed to inject code into the application, they could copy your session and use it from another device, as if they were you, until it expires after 8 hours. Signing out removes the copy in your browser, but does not invalidate a copy that was already stolen. Sign out when you finish on shared computers.

clauses.title: 4. Your preferences, only if you accept them
clauses.body: The language, the theme, the text size, whether you hid the assistant, its position on the screen and the projects view. Until you answer the notice, none of them is saved. If you reject them, Kontrol works the same but forgets them when you reload, and any already saved are deleted.

clauses.title: 5. External services
clauses.body: To display the interface, your browser downloads fonts from Google Fonts and the Google logo from Icons8. If you sign in with Google or attach files, it also connects to Google or Cloudinary. Those services receive your IP address and technical request data; Kontrol does not store anything in your browser on their behalf.

clauses.title: 6. How to change your choice or delete everything
clauses.body: You can change your choice below, from Cookie preferences in the footer or in Settings. To delete everything, clear this site's data in your browser settings. This does not remove your account information from Kontrol's servers.

ai.title: AI Assistant Usage Notice

clauses.title: 1. What it is
clauses.body: Kontrol AI is an automated assistant that answers questions about your business by querying your data. It is read-only: it does not create, change or delete anything, and it does not send messages on your behalf. The help bubble (Birdie) is not this assistant: it shows prewritten answers and does not use artificial intelligence.

clauses.title: 2. It can be wrong
clauses.body: The assistant can misread the question, query the wrong data, add up incorrectly or leave information out, and still sound confident. Do not use its answers as the only basis for financial, tax or inventory decisions: check the figures in Budget, Inventory, Sales or Reports before acting. Its recommendations are not accounting, tax or legal advice.

clauses.title: 3. What it can see
clauses.body: Only the company you are working in, with your own permissions: owners, administrators and managers see all of its projects; everyone else sees only the projects they are assigned to. From those it sees projects, tasks, budgets, progress, reports, evidence, inventory and suppliers with their contacts, and the name, email and phone of the people working on them. Never passwords. It does not see other companies, chats between people or your integrations.

clauses.title: 4. What is sent to the model
clauses.body: Your question and up to ten previous messages; your email, your role and the company name; the list of projects you can see and the table structure; and real data from your business: up to 20 rows per query, with at most five queries per question. Greetings, help and four common questions (budget, project status, low stock and overdue tasks) are answered inside Kontrol without calling the model.

clauses.title: 5. Who processes it and where
clauses.body: The model is Qwen, run with vLLM on ClawStitch, a server owned by the Kontrol team and located in Guatemala. Your data does not go to OpenAI, Google, Anthropic or any other external artificial intelligence provider.

clauses.title: 6. No training and no retention in the model
clauses.body: What you send is not used to train or improve any model. The model server processes the request, returns the answer and does not keep questions, data or answers. Because the server is our own, there are no external provider terms: this is the position of the team that runs it.

clauses.title: 7. What Kontrol keeps
clauses.body: Your conversations (questions, answers and the text of the queries that were run, not their results) so you can see your history; only you can see them, and they are kept until you delete them. If the assistant fails, the server logs the error so it can be fixed. You can delete messages or whole conversations from the assistant, and closing your account deletes all of your assistant history.

clauses.title: 8. If you do not want to use it
clauses.body: The assistant cannot be turned off in settings, but it only works when you write to it: if you do not ask it anything, nothing is sent to the model. To delete what is already stored, remove your conversations. For questions or requests about your data, write to {email}.
